/* PHIBOT_PHYSICAL_OBSERVER_PANEL_V0_3_BEGIN */
(function installPhysicalObserverPanel() {
  const PANEL_ID = "pv-physical-observer-v03";
  const MAX_PAYLOAD_CHARS = 262144;
  const MAX_VISIBLE_PROMPTS = 8;
  const observer = createPhysicalObserverRuntime();
  const receipts = [];

  function mount() {
    if (!document.body || document.getElementById(PANEL_ID)) return;

    const host = document.createElement("div");
    host.id = PANEL_ID;
    const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: "closed" });

    const style = document.createElement("style");
    style.textContent = [
      ":host {all:initial; font:14px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif; color:#d8f4ef}",
      ".launcher {position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:2147483646;background:#153c42;color:#c8fff2;border:1px solid #66bfa8;border-radius:999px;padding:11px 16px;font:600 13px system-ui;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 25px #0008}",
      ".panel {position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:70px;z-index:2147483646;box-sizing:border-box;width:min(390px,calc(100vw - 32px));max-height:min(75vh,680px);overflow:auto;background:#101d27;color:#e2f3f1;border:1px solid #467e79;border-radius:13px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px #000b;font:13px/1.5 system-ui}",
      ".panel[hidden]{display:none}",
      "h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:16px;color:#aefadd}",
      "h3{margin:12px 0 4px;font-size:13px;color:#aefadd}",
      "p{margin:5px 0 9px}",
      ".caution{color:#ffdbab}",
      "textarea{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:104px;resize:vertical;background:#09141b;color:#ebfff5;border:1px solid #4c7f81;border-radius:6px;padding:9px;font:12px/1.3 monospace}",
      "button{background:#1b4851;color:#d7fff4;border:1px solid #65a7a5;border-radius:7px;padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer}",
      "button:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #e3fbac;outline-offset:2px}",
      ".actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:8px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}",
      ".result{border-top:1px solid #355660;padding-top:8px;white-space:normal}",
      ".item{border:1px solid #395962;border-radius:7px;padding:9px;margin:8px 0;background:#132833;overflow-wrap:anywhere}",
      ".meta{font-size:11px;color:#b6d5d1;overflow-wrap:anywhere}",
      ".status{font-weight:600;color:#d8ffcc}"
    ].join("\n");

    const launcher = document.createElement("button");
    launcher.type = "button";
    launcher.className = "launcher";
    launcher.textContent = "Physical Observer";
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-label", "Open physical observer");
    launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");

    const panel = document.createElement("section");
    panel.className = "panel";
    panel.hidden = true;
    panel.setAttribute("aria-label", "Physical experience observer");

    const title = document.createElement("h2");
    title.textContent = "PhiBot Physical Observer";

    const description = document.createElement("p");
    description.textContent =
      "Operator-imported NBG advisory packets only. Read-only evidence and questions, never hardware commands.";

    const caution = document.createElement("p");
    caution.className = "caution";
    caution.textContent =
      "Import does not establish source authenticity, diagnosis, safety, or permission to use tools.";

    const input = document.createElement("textarea");
    input.maxLength = MAX_PAYLOAD_CHARS;
    input.setAttribute("aria-label", "Paste NBG physical handoff JSON");
    input.setAttribute("placeholder", "Paste an NBG PhiBot physical handoff JSON packet");
    input.setAttribute("autocomplete", "off");

    const actions = document.createElement("div");
    actions.className = "actions";

    const importButton = document.createElement("button");
    importButton.type = "button";
    importButton.textContent = "Review evidence";

    const clearButton = document.createElement("button");
    clearButton.type = "button";
    clearButton.textContent = "Clear";

    const closeButton = document.createElement("button");
    closeButton.type = "button";
    closeButton.textContent = "Close";

    const result = document.createElement("div");
    result.className = "result";
    result.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");

    function line(parent, content, className = "") {
      const p = document.createElement("p");
      p.textContent = String(content);
      if (className) p.className = className;
      parent.appendChild(p);
      return p;
    }

    function setMessage(message) {
      result.replaceChildren();
      line(result, message, "status");
    }

    function showView(view, receipt) {
      result.replaceChildren();
      line(result, "ADVISORY ONLY: NO TOOL OR PHYSICAL AUTHORITY", "caution");
      line(result, "Physical memory: " + String(view.queryMemoryId ?? "unknown"));
      line(result, "Similar history records: " + String(view.historyMatchCount ?? 0));
      for (const question of (view.questions ?? []).slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_PROMPTS)) {
        const item = document.createElement("div");
        item.className = "item";
        const h3 = document.createElement("h3");
        h3.textContent = String(question.subject ?? "Observation");
        item.appendChild(h3);
        line(item, String(question.question ?? "No question supplied"));
        line(item, String(question.readOnlyObservationSuggestion ?? "No read-only observation proposed"));
        line(item, "Source records: " + (question.evidenceMemoryIds ?? []).slice(0, 6).join(", "), "meta");
        line(item, "Evidence IDs: " + (question.evidenceIds ?? []).slice(0, 6).join(", "), "meta");
        line(item, String(question.boundary ?? "No action authority"), "caution");
        result.appendChild(item);
      }
      const uncertainties = view.uncertainty ?? [];
      line(result, "Uncertainty: " + (uncertainties.join(", ") || "No additional marker"), "meta");
      line(result, "Receipt SHA-256: " + String(receipt?.receiptSha256 ?? "not available"), "meta");
    }

    launcher.addEventListener("click", () => {
      panel.hidden = !panel.hidden;
      launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!panel.hidden));
    });
    closeButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      panel.hidden = true;
      launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    });
    clearButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      observer.clear();
      receipts.length = 0;
      input.value = "";
      setMessage("Ephemeral physical observer view cleared.");
    });

    importButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      importButton.disabled = true;
      try {
        if (!input.value || input.value.length > MAX_PAYLOAD_CHARS) {
          setMessage("REFUSED: missing or oversized JSON packet.");
          return;
        }
        const packet = JSON.parse(input.value);
        const received = await observer.receive(packet);
        if (received.status === "DISPLAYED_ADVISORY_ONLY" || received.status === "DUPLICATE") {
          if (received.view) showView(received.view, received.receipt);
          else setMessage("Duplicate packet already received; no new observer view.");
        } else {
          setMessage("REFUSED: " + (received.errors ?? [received.status]).join(", "));
        }
      } catch {
        setMessage("REFUSED: invalid or unsupported physical handoff payload.");
      } finally {
        importButton.disabled = false;
      }
    });

    actions.append(importButton, clearButton, closeButton);
    panel.append(title, description, caution, input, actions, result);
    shadow.append(style, launcher, panel);
    document.body.appendChild(host);
    setMessage("No physical handoff imported. No live telemetry connection.");
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mount, { once: true });
  } else {
    mount();
  }
})();
/* PHIBOT_PHYSICAL_OBSERVER_PANEL_V0_3_END */
